text:
Priya (CS): Quick heads-up — we have gaps in next week's office-hours roster, mainly APAC evenings. Can folks cover Wed/Thu 8pm IST? Also need to confirm who will do the post-session handback and send the short survey link after each session.

Jon (Enablement): I can take Wed 8pm IST. I’ll prep a 20-min demo + 10-min Q&A. Can someone add the agenda to the event?

Lena (CS Ops): I’ll grab Thu 8pm IST. @Priya can you drop the survey link here? Also note we need captions enabled for APAC participants.

Priya (CS): Survey link: https://rwd.io/surveys/enable-quick (short form). Agenda template below — please paste into event description:

```
20m: walkthrough (demo workspace)
10m: Q&A and live troubleshooting
5m: next steps + survey link + recording handback owner
```

Mark (Support): I can do captions and take the recording handback for Wed — will upload to shared drive and ping post. :thumbsup:

CalendarBot: Event updated — Wed 20:00 IST assigned to Jon, Thu 20:00 IST assigned to Lena. Reminders: 24h, 1h.

Aisha (CS): Quick ask — can we add a 1-slide pre-read for customers migrating to Dedicated? I can author and share by EOD today.

Priya (CS): Yes please — add to the event doc and tag the session as "migration-focused" so CS can route invites. After sessions, whoever owns recording, please: 1) upload, 2) post link in #customer-success, 3) trigger survey follow-up (Lena — can you automate?).

Lena (CS Ops): I’ll automate survey emails via our cadence tool. Will confirm the automation rule once recordings are up.

Jon (Enablement): Cool. I’ll add the agenda and pre-read link. See you Wed.

Priya (CS): Thanks all — tagging follow-ups: @Mark to upload, @Lena to automate surveys, @Aisha for pre-read. If anyone needs timezone help, DM me. :sparkles:
